I talked with our engineer again.
It is not easy to recommend a supplier suited for your needs.

1, source codes are the very most confidential information.
It is almost impossible to share it even if the quantity is huge or some
kind of agreement is signed.

2, technical support is complicated, SDK/API etc.
Most small companies are not CAPABLE of good and continuous support.

Maybe try TP-link, H3C etc.
Those big brands might be interested and CAPABLE.
Capability is the most basic part.

Thank you.

subj: OEM and SDK for National product
text:
Greetings.

Your contact was kindly provided by Simon from Olycom.

We are currently looking to establish a partnership with a hardware manufacturer, not a reseller or distributor.


Our goal is to create a national IT hardware solution for Uzbekistan by integrating your hardware with our own nationally developed software stack.

We are particularly interested in the possibility of obtaining sample units of your switches in disassembled form, branded with our logo, along with the necessary rights to modify the onboard operating system.

All assembly, integration, and software compilation would be carried out locally in Uzbekistan by our engineering team. This is essential to meet our internal security requirements, including full transparency, ensuring the absence of any backdoors, and successful passing of SAST and DAST analysis.


The final product would be promoted and sold in the market as an Uzbek-manufactured switch, powered by national software and assembled within the country.


We would be happy to provide further details and explore how such a partnership could be mutually beneficial. Looking forward to your response.

Could you please confirm whether your company is a direct manufacturer of networking equipment? Could you also kindly confirm if you provide services related to OEM, SDK and something else?


Looking forward to your response.



Best regards,
Vladimir Xe
Latmedia Community

Thanks

subj: Proposal for Joint Venture and Trading Collaboration in Telecom Products
text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope this message finds you well.

We are reaching out to explore potential opportunities for a Joint Venture
and Trading Partnership with your esteemed organization, focusing on the
global distribution and development of high-quality telecom products.

As a company committed to innovation and excellence in the telecom
manufacturing sector, we are looking to collaborate with leading
international players to expand our market presence, leverage cutting-edge
technologies, and meet the growing global demand for advanced telecom
solutions.

We believe that a strategic alliance between our companies could result in
mutual growth by combining our respective strengths in product development,
manufacturing, and global distribution. Our aim is to establish a long-term
and mutually beneficial relationship focused on quality, efficiency, and
shared success.It is with great pleasure that we introduce Maharani
Autotech Pvt. Ltd., a leading manufacturer renowned for delivering
high-quality infrastructure products across Telecom, Renewable Energy, and
Smart City sectors. With over 20 years of industry experience, we have
proudly established ourselves as trusted partners to major industry
leaders, including Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd., Bharti Airtel Ltd., Indus
Towers Ltd., Amplus Energy Solutions Ltd., Delta Electronics Ltd., L&T, and
many others.

Our Expertise and Product Portfolio

1. Renewable Energy Solutions:

• Solar Panel Fabrication: We provide expertly engineered solar mounting
structures and components to ensure optimal performance for solar energy
projects. Our products are designed to meet stringent quality standards and
are adaptable for both commercial and residential applications.

• FRP Poles: Our Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic (FRP) Poles are
non-corrosive, lightweight, and maintenance-free, making them ideal for
solar energy installations and renewable energy projects. They offer
superior strength at a cost-effective price point.

2. Smart City Infrastructure:

• Towers and Poles: We manufacture a comprehensive range of poles for
telecom and smart city applications, including FRP Poles, GI Poles, and Hot
Dip Galvanized Poles. These products are custom-designed to meet specific
project requirements for durability and strength.

• Fiber Supporting Products: Our product lineup includes Pole Clamps,
Extension Brackets, Universal Clamps, and Cable Saddles, providing
essential infrastructure support for telecom networks and smart city
installations.

• Precast Foundations & Concrete Solutions: We offer specialized concrete
products including Meter Boxes, LT Panel Boxes, ODF Boxes, Metal Boxes, and
custom-designed RCC components such as Tree Guards and Bollards, designed
for lasting performance in urban environments.

3. Sheet Metal Components & Heavy Fabrication:

• Telecom Accessories: From Cable Saddles and Hanger Clamp Assemblies to
Universal Clamps and Pole Clamps, we specialize in the fabrication of sheet
metal components that support telecom infrastructure projects of any scale.

• Poles: We provide custom telecom poles (6m, 8m) and solar mounting
structures, ensuring precise fabrication to withstand harsh environmental
conditions and deliver long-term performance.

4. Specialized Products:

• MS Canopies: Our MS Canopies are precision-engineered to meet client
specifications, offering both functional and aesthetic value for
infrastructure projects.

• Manholes & Handholes: We manufacture a variety of FRP Manholes, RCC
Manholes, and Handholes in different sizes to meet infrastructure needs.
These products are engineered for durability and ease of installation.

• Highway & Toll Equipment: Essential components such as toll booths,
highway signs, and other infrastructure elements designed for durability
and safety.

Our Manufacturing Strengths

• State-of-the-Art Facilities: With fully automated production units in
Faridabad (Delhi NCR), Kolkata (West Bengal), and Deogarh (Jharkhand), we
are capable of delivering high-quality products with exceptional lead
times, meeting the demands of both domestic and international clients.

• Commitment to Quality: We adhere to ISO standards and industry norms,
ensuring the highest quality production processes. Our technical team is
committed to continuous innovation, R&D, and precision manufacturing,
ensuring that every product meets the highest performance standards.

• Custom Solutions: We pride ourselves on delivering tailored solutions for
each project. Whether it's sheet metal fabrication, heavy steel structures,
or solar infrastructure, we design and manufacture products to meet
specific client needs, ensuring perfect functionality and fit.

Why Choose Us?

• Trusted Partnerships: Our long-standing relationships with leading
companies in telecom and infrastructure sectors, such as Reliance Jio,
Airtel, L&T, and others, reflect our proven track record of delivering
reliable and high-quality products.

• Diverse Capabilities: Our extensive experience in sheet metal components,
heavy fabrication, and solar energy structures positions us as a versatile
partner for projects ranging from telecom towers to solar power
installations and smart city infrastructure.

• Focus on Innovation: We continuously invest in R&D to stay ahead of
industry trends, ensuring our products not only meet current demands but
also anticipate future technological advancements.

We invite you to explore how Maharani Autotech Pvt. Ltd. can contribute to
the success of your next project. Whether you are working on renewable
energy, smart city, or telecom infrastructure, we offer a comprehensive
range of high-quality products, customized solutions, and timely delivery.

We would appreciate the opportunity to discuss this proposal further and
explore possible areas of collaboration. Please let us know a convenient
time for a virtual meeting or if you require any preliminary information
about our company and capabilities.

Looking forward to your positive response.

Warm regards,
Maharani Autotech Private Limited
9585008181/9289301333
Website -www.maharaniautotech.com
